status: candidate for comparison; not an accepted replacement
request: Reduce fine detail while retaining the accepted forms and readable contrast; compare old and new on one continuous map.
method: Four shape-preserving edits of accepted opaque tiles. Export to210x210 RGB PNG; renderer unchanged.

review_notes.forms: Original major hills, peaks and arrangement retained recognizably; fine ridge fluting and fragmented lights reduced.
review_notes.hills_color: Generated hill candidates are greener/more saturated than the baseline; this is visible in the comparison, not an assertion of unchanged color.
review_notes.baseline_preservation: All four accepted PNG SHA-256 hashes checked unchanged.

assets.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit, SHAPE-LOCKED DETAIL REDUCTION. Retouch this SAME accepted terrain tile. Preserve its composition, number of hills/peaks, placement, size, exact recognizable major silhouettes, ridge routes and valleys. Do not redesign, merge, remove, add, move or enlarge landforms. Keep the ORIGINAL COLORS, SATURATION AND STRONG LIGHT/DARK CONTRAST of the input. The task is ONLY to remove about half the fine-scale interior detail: fine rock fluting, little branching creases, narrow decorative highlight streaks, tiny surface striations, fragmented light flecks and micro-jaggedness. Consolidate these tiny marks into the same underlying larger original painted surfaces. Keep all original main ridges and major illuminated/shadow faces clearly defined and crisp, with a few coherent cream lights rather than many choppy thin white marks. Terrain must remain dimensional, rich and clearly drawn. Do NOT blur, soften overall, bleach, desaturate, make pastel, increase saturation, fog over, turn into smooth cones, flat vector or low-poly. Maintain original natural feathered footslope-to-background integration; soften only those existing base transitions, never the whole silhouette or all boundaries. Keep the same opaque grass/stone background, same hex-safe upright footprint, all peaks intact and same occupied area. Output a square opaque complete painted tile with no new borders, text, watermark, UI or transparency. Think faithful cleanup of fine detail by the original painter, not a new composition.
These are rounded grassy OPEN HILLS: retain EVERY original hill mound and its position, including the rear, middle and foreground hills. Simplify the small summit ripples and fine surface marks within each existing rounded mass; preserve the original rounded relief profile.
Preserve the source POINTY-TOP upright hex composition exactly.
